features.name: VN100 Liquidity Scanner
features.description: Dynamically selects top 15 most liquid stocks from VN100 index

features.name: 4-Signal Scoring Engine
features.description: Analyzes Volume Ratio, Smart Money (5D), Investor Type, and Price Momentum

features.name: Trap Detection System
features.description: Identifies retail FOMO and smart money distribution to avoid bull/bear traps

features.name: HTML Report Generator
features.description: Creates professional trading dashboards with color-coded signals

features.name: Backtest Engine
features.description: Simulates historical performance, calculates Win Rates and T+N returns to validate strategies

knowledge_items.pacing: API limits for community version require ~1.1s delay per request in scanner and ~2.5s per stock in detail analysis.
knowledge_items.encoding: Windows environment requires UTF-8 reconfiguration for console output to avoid UnicodeEncodeError.
knowledge_items.backtest_logic: Simulation must avoid 'Look-ahead bias' by strictly using pre-signal data for scoring and post-signal data for performance measuring.
